All ten pass. The whole reflow2-mcp suite passes with them: 108 test binaries, 696 tests, 0 failures. So do the gates that drive the real binary through the shared, degraded and stale-seat paths: test_shared_sessions, test_export_to_reaches_the_daemon, test_shared_attach_from_another_folder, test_degraded_server, test_stale_seat, test_latent_promotion, test_nudge_path, stateless_seat_probe, smoke_mcp, toolsnap. Clippy -D warnings and fmt are clean.

OBSERVED FAILING FIRST, on the released 0.72.0 binary: the same write-then-SIGTERM sequence exited 143 and the export did not contain the write.

The first run of the in-progress test failed on its own assertion, not on the behaviour: it expected the body to end in "done", but the answer is chunked and ends in the closing zero-length chunk. The assertion now reads the chunked form and also checks the connection closed.
